title: Status line of an external PII tool
description: The one JSON line an external PII tool (.jgates/pii.yml > tools) writes to stdout when it finishes. JGates copies the files to a temporary folder (JGATES_MASK_DIR, the working directory of the tool), lists them in JGATES_MASK_FILES (one relative path per line) and says the use in JGATES_MASK_MODE: context (masking the context of the semantic gate), check (detect only: nothing may change) or fix (correct the copy of project files). The tool edits the listed files in place and reports here what it did; JGates then checks the folder against this status (only listed files may change, no file created, removed or turned into a link, changed must match what changed). Exit code 0 with status ok is success; any other exit code or status error is a failure.

status.description: ok: the tool finished its work; error: it could not (nothing it did is used).

detected.description: The tool found sensitive data in at least one listed file.

changed.description: The tool changed at least one listed file. In check mode it must be false.

counts.description: What the tool found, per label (for example {"employee-id": 3}). The labels show in the result; the values never do.

files.description: The listed files (relative paths, as in JGATES_MASK_FILES) in which the tool found something.

message.description: A short note for the user. It must not carry a sensitive value.
